title: Nea Odi Kan a Ɔhwehwɛ Fafiri
intro: San w’akyi kɔ bere bi ansa na owia apue nea edi kan, ansa na onipa biara a owu anantew asase so. Wɔde nneɛma a ɛba fam sen biara na ɛyɛɛ ohoni bi, wɔmaa no gyinabea bi wɔ abɔfo no atifi, na wɔde sii turo kronkron bi mu a kɔkɔbɔ a emu da hɔ wom. Nanso wɔ bere tiaa bi mu no, wɔpaw biribi — nea ɛbɛka wɔ adesamma abakɔsɛm nyinaa mu. Hena ne saa akontaabu yi?
clues: Wɔde me baa nkwa mu wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnte sɛ ɔkwan foforo biara so — wɔde asase so mfutuma yɛɛ me na wɔde Ɔbɔadeɛ no nsa maa ɔkra teasefo.
Wɔmaa me nimdeɛ a emu dɔ araa ma abɔfo a wɔwɔ soro no mpo ho dwiriw wɔn.
Wɔhyɛɛ ɔsorofoɔ nyinaa sɛ wɔnkotow m’anim, na wɔn nyinaa brɛɛ wɔn ho ase — gye sɛ obiako, a ɛnam ahantan so powee.
Wɔde me too turo kronkron bi mu, beaeɛ a daa awerɛkyekyerɛ ne nsiesiei wɔ — nanso wɔbaraa me katee baako.
Me werɛ fii, mehwee ase, na meyɛɛ asoɔden — na metee me mfomso no mu duru nka kɛse.
Mede akoma mu nsɛm danee m’Awurade nkyɛn, na Ɔgyee me nsakyera toom, ɛfiri sɛ Ɔno ne Bɔnefakyɛfoɔ.

arabic: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَـٰتٍۢ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verse: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful. (2:37)
